paragraphs.text: Mira carried a lantern to the harbour before dawn. She counted four windows, then opened her notebook.
The harbour clock keeps the first quiet hour.
The keeper called this a lantern[1], a word explained in the final chapter.
At the edge of the quay Mira found a folded map, and she carried it across the sleeping town without losing a single corner.
